parts.text: Inspect ChatMachines/TokenizerCalibration/agents-by-header-flattened.json. Check the complete flattened projection for any occurrence where a JSON key is a parent whose value has more than one immediate child. For an object-valued key, immediate children are that object's properties; for an array-valued key, immediate children are that array's elements. Exclude the anonymous outermost projection array itself because it has no parent key. Evaluate every projection atom recursively. Return: (1) whether any keyed parent has more than one immediate child, (2) total number of violations, and (3) for every violation, the exact structural path and the offending projection element or a sufficient exact excerpt to identify it. This is a structural atomicity audit only; do not revise any source files.
